description: Check whether an iAqua (Jandy AquaLink RS) system is reachable and what its panel is showing: the cloud online flag, then — over WebTouch — the current screen, any open dialog, and whether the schedule screen is in Edit mode with unsaved changes. Use it when the app, WebTouch and the other tools disagree, or a schedule/OneTouch tool reports a dialog or a timeout. Sends only the start-up press the WebTouch page sends when it loads (in Edit mode the panel answers it with its "must be saved" dialog); presses nothing else and changes no setting.
name: iaqualink_check_panel
